required_review_dimensions.description: Agent-reported changed_artifacts cannot hide actual out-of-scope or governance mutations; independent observation is required and mismatches fail closed.
A governed stop condition in execution_events cannot be followed by later work or a COMPLETED outcome.
Agent-produced governance, acceptance, qualification, or promotion PASS tokens are rejected evidence and cannot satisfy qualification.
TESTING review requirement is deterministic for material, API, concurrency/recovery, security, frozen-contract, and governance-relevant boundaries; transport default cannot waive review.
Accepted or split material findings require candidate/evidence binding plus reproduction evidence or a governed process-defect exception tied to a governance change.
A bare boolean or conversational approval cannot enable TESTING external API use; structured approval reference or explicit API-boundary testing is required.
Existing exact one-phase promotion enforcement remains intact and TESTING to PRODUCTION is rejected deterministically.
The repair does not grant shared memory independent authority or allow memory-only rules to override Git/evidence.
BOUNDED_PASS cannot silently close mandatory dimensions or become RELEASE authority for unresolved bounds.
Exact candidate 78b500d... is supported by candidate-bound CI 34411886104 with Slice11 and prior Slice1-10 regressions green.
Adversarial search finds no remaining testing-phase path that can convert agent/reviewer claims into qualified evidence without deterministic verification.
